boards.name: The Blighted Marsh
boards.layout: Scattered toxic pools around a central dry grove; branching boardwalk loop.

boards.name: Shadowfen Forest
boards.layout: Central clearing with radial forest paths and a small rear-edge pond.

boards.name: The Cursed Mire
boards.layout: Disconnected peat pools, dead woods and broken causeways.

boards.name: Dragon's Rest
boards.layout: Volcanic island with basalt paths and lava crossings.

boards.name: Frostpeaks
boards.layout: Horseshoe glacier basin with three separate frozen lakes and switchbacks.

boards.name: Stormcrown Mountains
boards.layout: Layered rear ridges and a summit approach above broad alpine meadow.

boards.name: The Iron Plains
boards.layout: East-west road crossroads through fields and short earthworks; isolated pond.

boards.name: Drakeshard Range
boards.layout: U-shaped dry canyon with zigzag trails and isolated spring.

boards.name: The Golden Expanse
boards.layout: Dry dune sea around a single left-edge oasis and stone mesas.

boards.name: The Ember Coast
boards.layout: Coastal cliffs and short tidal inlets around volcanic ground.

boards.name: The Hollow Isles
boards.layout: Separate islands connected by causeways and tidal flats.

boards.name: Westhaven Coast
boards.layout: Sea confined to west edge with two coves; dry central crossroads.
